nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Broken glass. The shelves are bare. Behind the counter, someone is filling a backpack.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Whoa. Nope. Not a cop. You're not a cop. You've got a mom face.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Okay, silent type. Cool. Love that. Very scary. What do you want, Sparky?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She's maybe nineteen. Hoodie, no coat. Her hands are shaking, and it isn't cold yet.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Or what? You'll shoplift me?

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Insulin. Fridge stuff. Fridge is dead. Most of it's warm junk now.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: I got four pens and a vial. Cold-ish. I got buyers for 'em.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Outside, a flashlight beam. Boots. A man's voice: 'Block watch! Who's in there?'

choices.text: Give me the vial and go.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: ...Huh. Okay. Weird. Thanks, Sparky.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She tosses one insulin pen on the counter as she goes. On the wall: a Sharpie note. 'Sorry. —W'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You find nothing else. The watchman sweeps his light past you and moves on.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Deal. You're bad at robbing, you know that?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She's out the back door before the light reaches the counter.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Hey. HEY. That's... that's my whole week.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Remember my face, Sparky. Everybody's gonna need something.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She runs. The bag is heavy: insulin, antibiotics, someone's heart pills.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: 'In here!' The watchman charges in. Wren is gone. He finds you with your hands full.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: I'm Dell Kowalczyk. Fourth Street. My kid's diabetic.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He lowers the rifle. Slowly. 'Take what you need. Then get home. Curfew's eight.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Tomorrow there'll be a sign in the window: LOOTERS WILL BE SHOT. Hand-painted.
